provenance.paper_title: Analytic Concept-Centric Memory for Agentic Embodied Manipulation

evidence.paraphrase: Objects, parts, poses, affordances, states, action transitions, and skills are connected for coarse-to-fine retrieval.

Fixed analytic templates update object and scene state as manipulation changes the environment. For Analytic Concept-Centric Memory, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of concept-centric manipulation memory.

Transition memory records action-induced changes to keep retrieved states consistent. For Analytic Concept-Centric Memory, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of concept-centric manipulation memory.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (concept-centric manipulation memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, fixed-rule correction of stored state; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
